tasks.gr11-ml-interest-banking-t2: Grade 11 Mathematical Literacy Term 2 — Finance: Interest, Banking and Inflation. Ask learners to calculate simple interest (SI = P × i × n) and compound interest (A = P(1 + i)^n), compare simple and compound growth in context, interpret the effect of inflation on spending power and real value of savings, read and compare banking fee structures, and make evidence-based financial decisions. Use South African banking and savings contexts.
tasks.gr11-ml-measurement-t2: Grade 11 Mathematical Literacy Term 2 — Measurement. Ask learners to measure and convert length, mass, volume and temperature (°C to °F: F = 1.8C + 32; and back), read analogue and digital measuring instruments accurately, solve practical problems that combine mixed units (e.g. recipe scaling, building materials), and estimate reasonable measurements in everyday contexts.
tasks.gr11-ml-maps-plans-t2: Grade 11 Mathematical Literacy Term 2 — Maps, Plans and Scale. Ask learners to interpret a given map scale (e.g. 1:50 000) to convert map distances to actual distances, measure distances on maps using a ruler and scale, compare the lengths of two routes and justify a choice, read a simple floor plan and determine room dimensions, and understand the concept of a plan view. Use South African maps and local building plans.
tasks.gr11-ml-midyear-prep-t2: Grade 11 Mathematical Literacy Term 2 — Revision and Mid-year Preparation. Ask integrated questions combining finance (interest, tariffs, documents), measurement (conversions, temperature) and map/scale skills. Questions should mirror mid-year examination style: multi-step problems, selecting relevant data from provided documents, showing working clearly, and writing short explanations or conclusions in context.
